website.note: Site lists PUR3100, PUR1900, PUR1800 as legacy assets; details on linked pages not extractable.

ctgov.note: All 14 Pulmatrix-sponsored studies are COMPLETED or TERMINATED.

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Pulmatrix has paused all clinical development of PUR3100 (Phase 2-ready, IND accepted Sep 2023), PUR1800 (completed Phase 1b 2022), and PUR1900 (Phase 2 trials terminated 2024) pending the proposed merger with Cullgen, Inc. Per the FY2025 10-K, the company is seeking to monetize iSPERSE technology and clinical assets and has no active P1/P2/P3 trials enrolling.

excluded_legacy_terminated.reason: Phase 1 completed 2022; Phase 2 IND accepted but trial not initiated, development paused
